name: Web Performance Budget Checker API
shortDescription: Bucket page resource weights by asset class and check them against a performance budget — pass/warn/fail
description: Agent-native performance-budget checker computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /check buckets per-resource weights (or pre-aggregated class totals) into html/css/js/image/font/media/other, compares each class and the page total against a budget (sensible mobile-perf defaults, fully overridable), and returns pass/warn/fail with over-by KB and the worst offenders. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and prioritized fixes. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.
